nodes.name: Todoist Trigger
nodes.notes:
Polls Todoist for new tasks.

After importing, open this node and:
1. Select your Todoist credential
2. Under 'Filters', add a project filter for 'Backlog'

Alternatively, keep it unfiltered and add a Filter node before the Code node.

Output fields used downstream:
  - id (task ID)
  - content (task name)
  - description (task description)
  - priority (1-4, where 4 = p1/urgent)

nodes.name: Extract Keyword
nodes.notes:
Transforms the raw Todoist task into a clean payload for the rest of the workflow.

Fields produced:
  keyword         — text used to search for a matching epic
  taskId          — Todoist task ID (stored on the Notion ticket)
  taskName        — becomes the Notion ticket title
  taskDescription — becomes the Notion ticket description
  taskPriority    — mapped to Notion select (Urgent / High / Medium / Low)
  taskUrl         — link back to the Todoist task

nodes.name: Search Epics
nodes.notes:
Queries the 🗺️ Epics database for a page whose title contains the keyword.

After importing, open this node and add a filter:
  Property: Name
  Condition: Contains
  Value: {{ $json.keyword }}

If no matching epic is found, the IF node routes to Create Epic.
Otherwise, the first match is used as the linked epic.

nodes.name: Epic Found?
nodes.notes:
Routes the flow based on whether the Notion search returned any results.

TRUE  (epic found)    → goes directly to Create Backlog Ticket
FALSE (no epic found) → goes to Create Epic first, then Create Backlog Ticket

Both branches converge at Create Backlog Ticket so there is only one ticket-creation node.

nodes.name: Create Epic
nodes.notes:
Creates a new page in the 🗺️ Epics database.

Only runs when no matching epic was found (IF false branch).
Uses the keyword extracted from the task name as the epic title.

The newly created page ID flows into Create Backlog Ticket for the
Epic relation.

nodes.name: Create Backlog Ticket
nodes.notes:
Creates the backlog ticket in the 📥 Backlog database with all fields mapped from the Todoist task.

This node runs regardless of whether an epic was found or created.
It receives the epic page from either:
  - Search Epics → IF (true)  → here   (found epic)
  - Search Epics → IF (false) → Create Epic → here   (new epic)

In both cases, {{ $json.id }} resolves to the epic's Notion page ID.

All database IDs and property names are pre-configured to match
the 🗺️ Epics and 📥 Backlog databases in the AI Dashboard workspace.
